ward.summary: Colaba, Fort and Churchgate (ward A) spent ₹16.6 lakh against a ₹16.0 lakh budget, or 103%, so it is over budget. Of 29 jobs, 38% were redone within 30 days, against 26% expected, which is in line with expectations; ₹5.8 lakh went on repairs that failed. Two jobs are listed for review. Nine jobs, costing ₹3.6 lakh, were paid on roads under warranty. Six issues remain open, costing ₹0.8 lakh to fix, starting with potholes on Veer Nariman Road and Colaba Causeway. With ₹0 left, the budget covers none of them, so money must be reallocated or warranty payments recovered.
